(* Classic validation list library (generated by scripts/classic_listops.py from the accepted
   certificates/classic_util_list/ClassicListOps.v, re-bound to this export).  Features: @FEATURES@ *)
From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool ssrfun eqtype ssrnat seq.
From LeanImport Require Import Lean.
From FoundationImported Require Import @IMPORTED@.
From FoundationCertificates Require Import PropSPropFoundation LogicalRelation
  SubadditivityNatCorrespondence @BASE@.

Module I := @IMPORTED@.

(** Sequences are related to Lean lists through an element conversion [c]
    (the identity for identified carriers, the pair conversion for pairs):
    [ClListRel c sR sL := Lean.eq (cl_map c sR) sL].  Every operation lemma
    relates the MathComp operation on [sR] to the Lean operation on the
    converted list, by structural induction; the Lean side is unfolded one
    constructor at a time by conversion only. *)

parts.core:
Lemma cl_nat_logic nR nL : SubNatRel nR nL -> Logic.eq nL (sub_nat_to_imported nR).
Proof. intro H. exact (Logic.eq_sym (imported_eq_to_coq_eq _ _ H)). Qed.

Lemma cl_nat_input nR nL : SubNatRel nR nL -> Logic.eq (sub_nat_to_rocq nL) nR.
Proof. intro H. rewrite (cl_nat_logic _ _ H). exact (sub_nat_rocq_roundtrip nR). Qed.

Lemma cl_lean_eq (A : Type) (x y : A) : Logic.eq x y -> Lean.eq x y.
Proof. exact (coq_eq_to_imported_eq x y). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(** * Conversions *)

Fixpoint cl_map {A B : Type} (c : A -> B) (s : seq A) : I.List B :=
  match s with [::] => I.List_nil B | x :: s' => I.List_cons B (c x) (cl_map c s') end.

Fixpoint cl_unmap {A B : Type} (d : B -> A) (l : I.List B) : seq A :=
  match l with I.List_nil => [::] | I.List_cons x l' => d x :: cl_unmap d l' end.

Lemma cl_unmap_map {A B : Type} (c : A -> B) (d : B -> A) (Hdc : forall x, Logic.eq (d (c x)) x) s :
  Logic.eq (cl_unmap d (cl_map c s)) s.
Proof. elim: s => [|x s IH] //=. by rewrite Hdc IH. Qed.

Lemma cl_map_unmap {A B : Type} (c : A -> B) (d : B -> A) (Hcd : forall y, Logic.eq (c (d y)) y) l :
  Logic.eq (cl_map c (cl_unmap d l)) l.
Proof. induction l as [|y l IH]; first reflexivity. cbn. by rewrite Hcd IH. Qed.

Definition ClListRel {A B : Type} (c : A -> B) (sR : seq A) (sL : I.List B) : SProp := Lean.eq (cl_map c sR) sL.

Lemma cl_list_logic {A B} (c : A -> B) sR sL : ClListRel c sR sL -> Logic.eq sL (cl_map c sR).
Proof. intro H. exact (Logic.eq_sym (imported_eq_to_coq_eq _ _ H)). Qed.

Lemma cl_forall_list {A B : Type} (c : A -> B) (d : B -> A) (Hcd : forall y, Logic.eq (c (d y)) y)
    (PR : seq A -> Prop) (PL : I.List B -> SProp) :
  (forall sR sL, ClListRel c sR sL -> PropSPropRel (PR sR) (PL sL)) ->
  PropSPropRel (forall s, PR s) (forall s, PL s).
Proof.
  intro H. apply prop_sprop_rel_intro.
  - intros HR sL.
    exact (prop_to_sprop _ _ (H _ _ (cl_lean_eq _ _ _ (cl_map_unmap c d Hcd sL))) (HR _)).
  - intro HL. apply strictly_inhabits. intro sR.
    exact (sprop_to_prop _ _ (H sR (cl_map c sR) (@Lean.eq_refl _ _)) (HL _)).
Qed.
parts.size:
Lemma cl_size {A B} (c : A -> B) s : SubNatRel (size s) (I.List_length B (cl_map c s)).
Proof. apply: cl_lean_eq. elim: s => [|x s IH] //=. by rewrite IH. Qed.
parts.cat:
Lemma cl_cat {A B} (c : A -> B) s1 s2 :
  Logic.eq (cl_map c (s1 ++ s2))
    (I.HAppend_hAppend (I.List B) (I.List B) (I.List B) (I.instHAppendOfAppend (I.List B) (I.List_instAppend B))
       (cl_map c s1) (cl_map c s2)).
Proof. elim: s1 => [|x s1 IH] //=. by rewrite IH. Qed.

Lemma cl_rcons {A B} (c : A -> B) s x :
  Logic.eq (cl_map c (rcons s x))
    (I.HAppend_hAppend (I.List B) (I.List B) (I.List B) (I.instHAppendOfAppend (I.List B) (I.List_instAppend B))
       (cl_map c s) (I.List_cons B (c x) (I.List_nil B))).
Proof. by rewrite -cats1 cl_cat. Qed.
parts.mapop:
Lemma cl_map_op {A B A' B'} (c : A -> B) (c' : A' -> B') (fR : A -> A') (fL : B -> B')
    (Hf : forall x, Logic.eq (fL (c x)) (c' (fR x))) s :
  Logic.eq (cl_map c' (map fR s)) (I.List_map B B' fL (cl_map c s)).
Proof. elim: s => [|x s IH] //=. rewrite IH -Hf. reflexivity. Qed.
parts.filter:
Lemma cl_filter {A B} (c : A -> B) (pR : A -> bool) (pL : B -> I.Bool)
    (Hp : forall x, CtBoolRel (pR x) (pL (c x))) s :
  Logic.eq (cl_map c (filter pR s)) (I.List_filter B pL (cl_map c s)).
Proof.
  elim: s => [|x s IH] //=.
  have -> : Logic.eq (I.List_filter B pL (I.List_cons B (c x) (cl_map c s)))
      (match pL (c x) with
       | I.Bool_true => I.List_cons B (c x) (I.List_filter B pL (cl_map c s))
       | I.Bool_false => I.List_filter B pL (cl_map c s) end).
  { cbn. destruct (pL (c x)); reflexivity. }
  rewrite (ct_bool_rel_logic _ _ (Hp x)) -IH. by case: (pR x).
Qed.
parts.take:
Lemma cl_take {A B} (c : A -> B) : forall n s,
  Logic.eq (cl_map c (take n s)) (I.List_take B (sub_nat_to_imported n) (cl_map c s)).
Proof. elim => [|n IH] [|x s] //=. by rewrite IH. Qed.
parts.nth:
Lemma cl_nth {A B} (c : A -> B) (x0 : A) : forall s n,
  Logic.eq (c (nth x0 s n)) (I.List_getD B (cl_map c s) (sub_nat_to_imported n) (c x0)).
Proof. elim => [|x s IH] [|n] //=. Qed.
parts.zip:
Lemma cl_zip {A B A' B'} (c : A -> B) (c' : A' -> B') : forall s1 s2,
  Logic.eq (cl_map (fun p => I.Prod_mk B B' (c p.1) (c' p.2)) (zip s1 s2)) (I.List_zip B B' (cl_map c s1) (cl_map c' s2)).
Proof. elim => [|x s IH] [|y t] //=. by rewrite IH. Qed.
parts.nseq:
Lemma cl_nseq {A B} (c : A -> B) (y : A) : forall n,
  Logic.eq (cl_map c (nseq n y)) (I.List_replicate B (sub_nat_to_imported n) (c y)).
Proof. elim => [|n IH] //=. by rewrite IH. Qed.
parts.pmap:
Lemma cl_pmap {A B A' B'} (c : A -> B) (c' : A' -> B') (fR : A -> option A') (fL : B -> I.Option B')
    (Hf : forall x, Logic.eq (fL (c x)) (cl_opt (omap c' (fR x)))) s :
  Logic.eq (cl_map c' (pmap fR s)) (I.List_filterMap B B' fL (cl_map c s)).
Proof.
  elim: s => [|x s IH] //=.
  have -> : Logic.eq (I.List_filterMap B B' fL (I.List_cons B (c x) (cl_map c s)))
      (match fL (c x) with
       | I.Option_some z => I.List_cons B' z (I.List_filterMap B B' fL (cl_map c s))
       | I.Option_none => I.List_filterMap B B' fL (cl_map c s) end).
  { cbn. destruct (fL (c x)); reflexivity. }
  rewrite Hf -IH. by case: (fR x).
Qed.
parts.all:
Lemma cl_all {A B} (c : A -> B) (pR : A -> bool) (pL : B -> I.Bool)
    (Hp : forall x, CtBoolRel (pR x) (pL (c x))) s :
  CtBoolRel (all pR s) (I.List_all B (cl_map c s) pL).
Proof.
  apply: cl_lean_eq. elim: s => [|x s IH] //=.
  have -> : Logic.eq (I.List_all B (I.List_cons B (c x) (cl_map c s)) pL)
      (I.Bool_and (pL (c x)) (I.List_all B (cl_map c s) pL)).
  { cbn. destruct (pL (c x)); reflexivity. }
  rewrite -IH (ct_bool_rel_logic _ _ (Hp x)). by case: (pR x); case: (all pR s).
Qed.
parts.mem:
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(** * Membership, uniqueness, index (eqTypes) *)

Section Eq.
Variables (A : eqType) (B : Type) (c : A -> B) (d : B -> A).
Hypothesis Hdc : forall x, Logic.eq (d (c x)) x.
Hypothesis Hcd : forall y, Logic.eq (c (d y)) y.

Lemma cl_c_inj x y : Logic.eq (c x) (c y) -> Logic.eq x y.
Proof. move=> E. by rewrite -(Hdc x) -(Hdc y) E. Qed.

Definition cl_false_elim_s (Q : SProp) (H : is_true false) : Q :=
  match (Bool.diff_false_true H) return Q with end.

Fixpoint cl_mem_forward (x : A) (s : seq A) {struct s} : x \in s -> I.List_Mem B (c x) (cl_map c s) :=
  match s as s0 return x \in s0 -> I.List_Mem B (c x) (cl_map c s0) with
  | [::] => fun H => cl_false_elim_s _ H
  | y :: s' =>
      match @eqP A x y in reflect _ b return (b || (x \in s')) -> I.List_Mem B (c x) (I.List_cons B (c y) (cl_map c s')) with
      | ReflectT E => fun _ =>
          match E in Logic.eq _ z return I.List_Mem B (c x) (I.List_cons B (c z) (cl_map c s')) with
          | Logic.eq_refl => I.List_Mem_head B (c x) _
          end
      | ReflectF _ => fun H => I.List_Mem_tail B (c x) (c y) _ (cl_mem_forward x s' H)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint cl_mem_backward (a : B) (l : I.List B) (H : I.List_Mem B a l) : StrictlyInhabited (d a \in cl_unmap d l) :=
  match H with
  | I.List_Mem_head l' => strictly_inhabits (mem_head (d a) (cl_unmap d l'))
  | I.List_Mem_tail y l' Ht =>
      match cl_mem_backward a l' Ht with
      | strictly_inhabits Hm => strictly_inhabits (introT orP (or_intror Hm) : d a \in d y :: cl_unmap d l')
      end
  end.

Lemma cl_mem_rel x s : PropSPropRel (x \in s) (I.List_Mem B (c x) (cl_map c s)).
Proof.
  apply prop_sprop_rel_intro; first exact (cl_mem_forward x s).
  intro H. have S := cl_mem_backward _ _ H. rewrite Hdc (cl_unmap_map c d Hdc) in S. exact S.
Qed.

Lemma cl_mem_rel_list x s sL : ClListRel c s sL -> PropSPropRel (x \in s) (I.List_Mem B (c x) sL).
Proof. intro H. destruct H. exact (cl_mem_rel x s). Qed.

Lemma cl_notin_rel x s sL : ClListRel c s sL ->
  PropSPropRel (is_true (x \notin s)) (I.Not (I.List_Mem B (c x) sL)).
Proof.
  intro H. have M := cl_mem_rel_list x s sL H. apply prop_sprop_rel_intro.
  - move=> /negP N HL. exact (ct_coq_false_to_target (N (sprop_to_prop _ _ M HL))).
  - intro N. apply strictly_inhabits. apply/negP => Hm.
    exact (interpret_strict _ (ct_target_false_to_strict (N (prop_to_sprop _ _ M Hm)))).
Qed.

End Eq.
parts.uniq:
Section EqU.
Variables (A : eqType) (B : Type) (c : A -> B) (d : B -> A).
Hypothesis Hdc : forall x, Logic.eq (d (c x)) x.
Hypothesis Hcd : forall y, Logic.eq (c (d y)) y.

Fixpoint cl_uniq_forward (s : seq A) : uniq s -> I.List_Nodup B (cl_map c s).
Proof.
  destruct s as [|x s]; cbn.
  - intros _. exact (I.List_Pairwise_nil B (I.Ne B)).
  - intro H. destruct (andb_prop _ _ H) as [Hx Hs]. apply I.List_Pairwise_cons.
    + intros y Hy Exy.
      have Hy' := interpret_strict _ (cl_mem_backward A B d _ _ Hy).
      rewrite (cl_unmap_map c d Hdc) in Hy'.
      have E := imported_eq_to_coq_eq _ _ Exy. rewrite -E Hdc in Hy'.
      have F : Logic.False by rewrite Hy' in Hx.
      exact (ct_coq_false_to_target F).
    + exact (cl_uniq_forward s Hs).
Defined.

Lemma cl_uniq_backward (l : I.List B) : I.List_Nodup B l -> StrictlyInhabited (uniq (cl_unmap d l)).
Proof.
  intro H. induction H as [|y l Hpair Htail IH].
  - exact (strictly_inhabits (Logic.eq_refl true)).
  - destruct IH as [IHu]. apply strictly_inhabits. rewrite /= IHu andbT. apply/negP => Hm.
    have Hm' := cl_mem_forward A B c _ _ Hm. rewrite (cl_map_unmap c d Hcd) Hcd in Hm'.
    exact (interpret_strict _ (ct_target_false_to_strict (Hpair y Hm' (@Lean.eq_refl _ _)))).
Qed.

Lemma cl_uniq_rel s : PropSPropRel (uniq s) (I.List_Nodup B (cl_map c s)).
Proof.
  apply prop_sprop_rel_intro; first exact (cl_uniq_forward s).
  intro H. have S := cl_uniq_backward _ H. rewrite (cl_unmap_map c d Hdc) in S. exact S.
Qed.

Lemma cl_uniq_rel_list s sL : ClListRel c s sL -> PropSPropRel (uniq s) (I.List_Nodup B sL).
Proof. intro H. destruct H. exact (cl_uniq_rel s). Qed.


End EqU.
parts.index:
(** [index] against [idxOf] (through [findIdx.go] with its accumulator). *)
Lemma cl_findIdx_go (A : eqType) (x : A) (dec : I.DecidableEq A) (Hdec : forall a b, CtBoolRel (a == b) (I.Decidable_decide (Lean.eq a b) (dec a b))) :
  forall (s : seq A) n,
  Logic.eq (I.List_findIdx_go A (fun y => I.BEq_beq A (I.instBEqOfDecidableEq A dec) y x) (cl_map (fun z => z) s) (sub_nat_to_imported n))
           (sub_nat_to_imported (n + index x s)).
Proof.
  elim => [|y s IH] n.
  - by rewrite addn0.
  - have -> : Logic.eq (I.List_findIdx_go A (fun y => I.BEq_beq A (I.instBEqOfDecidableEq A dec) y x)
                 (cl_map (fun z => z) (y :: s)) (sub_nat_to_imported n))
       (match I.Decidable_decide (Lean.eq y x) (dec y x) with
        | I.Bool_true => sub_nat_to_imported n
        | I.Bool_false => I.List_findIdx_go A (fun y => I.BEq_beq A (I.instBEqOfDecidableEq A dec) y x)
                            (cl_map (fun z => z) s) (sub_nat_to_imported n.+1) end).
    { cbn. destruct (dec y x); reflexivity. }
    rewrite (ct_bool_rel_logic _ _ (Hdec y x)) /= eq_sym. case: (x == y) => /=.
    + by rewrite addn0.
    + rewrite (IH n.+1). by rewrite addSnnS.
Qed.

Lemma cl_index (A : eqType) (x : A) (dec : I.DecidableEq A) (Hdec : forall a b, CtBoolRel (a == b) (I.Decidable_decide (Lean.eq a b) (dec a b))) s :
  SubNatRel (index x s) (I.List_idxOf A (I.instBEqOfDecidableEq A dec) x (cl_map (fun z => z) s)).
Proof. apply: cl_lean_eq. exact (Logic.eq_sym (cl_findIdx_go A x dec Hdec s 0)). Qed.
parts.pair:
(** Pairs and options. *)
Definition cl_pair {A B : Type} (p : A * B) : I.Prod A B := I.Prod_mk A B p.1 p.2.
Definition cl_unpair {A B : Type} (p : I.Prod A B) : A * B := (I.Prod_fst A B p, I.Prod_snd A B p).
Lemma cl_unpair_pair {A B} (p : A * B) : Logic.eq (cl_unpair (cl_pair p)) p. Proof. by case: p. Qed.
Lemma cl_pair_unpair {A B} (p : I.Prod A B) : Logic.eq (cl_pair (cl_unpair p)) p. Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
parts.opt:
Definition cl_opt {A : Type} (o : option A) : I.Option A :=
  if o is Some x then I.Option_some A x else I.Option_none A.
Definition cl_unopt {A : Type} (o : I.Option A) : option A :=
  match o with I.Option_some x => Some x | I.Option_none => None end.
Lemma cl_unopt_opt {A} (o : option A) : Logic.eq (cl_unopt (cl_opt o)) o. Proof. by case: o. Qed.
Lemma cl_opt_unopt {A} (o : I.Option A) : Logic.eq (cl_opt (cl_unopt o)) o. Proof. by case: o. Qed.
parts.existslist:
Lemma cl_exists_list {A B : Type} (c : A -> B) (d : B -> A) (Hcd : forall y, Logic.eq (c (d y)) y)
    (PR : seq A -> Prop) (PL : I.List B -> SProp) :
  (forall sR sL, ClListRel c sR sL -> PropSPropRel (PR sR) (PL sL)) ->
  PropSPropRel (exists s, PR s) (I.Exists (I.List B) PL).
Proof.
  intro H. apply prop_sprop_rel_intro.
  - intros [sR HsR]. exact (I.Exists_intro _ PL (cl_map c sR) (prop_to_sprop _ _ (H _ _ (@Lean.eq_refl _ _)) HsR)).
  - intros [sL HsL]. apply strictly_inhabits. exists (cl_unmap d sL).
    exact (sprop_to_prop _ _ (H _ _ (cl_lean_eq _ _ _ (cl_map_unmap c d Hcd sL))) HsL).
Qed.
